Game Overview

Zombie Survivor - The Last Run is a zombie title where quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Zombie Survivor - The Last Run is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Zombie Survivor - The Last Run?

Zombie Survivor - The Last Run is a free zombie game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Zombie Survivor - The Last Run free to play?

Yes, Zombie Survivor - The Last Run is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
